passages.context: Section 8 was checked as the opening locus, and sections 8-14 were read in sequence across the crowd's finding Jesus, the exposure of bread-seeking, labor for enduring food, belief as God's work, and the manna dispute. Augustine's sign and belief reading supports Christian reception but does not erase the Johannine narrative or bodily hunger.

work.description: Augustine's one hundred and twenty-four tractates on the Gospel of John. Tractate CXX covers John 19:31 to 20:9 and Tractate CXXI takes up John 20:10. A locus is tractate.section. Edition records keep the Latin recensions, the printed translations, and dated web deliveries apart.
